fullPassage: A ball thrown into the air is acted upon by the initial force given it, persisting as inertia of movement and tending to carry it in the same straight line, and by the constant pull of gravity downward, as well as by the resistance of the air. It moves, accordingly, in a curved path. Now the path does not represent the working of any particular force; there is simply the combination of the three elementary forces mentioned; but in a real sense, there is something in the total action besides the isolated action of three forces, namely, their joint action. In the same way, when two or more human individuals are together, their mutual relationships and their arrangement into a group are things which would not be revealed if we confined our attention to each individual separately. The significance of group behavior is greatly increased in the case of human beings by the fact that some of the tendencies to action of the individual are related definitely to other persons, and could not be aroused except by other persons acting as stimuli. An individual in complete isolation would not reveal their competitive tendencies, their tendencies towards the opposite sex, their protective tendencies towards children. This shows that the traits of human nature do not fully appear until the individual is brought into relationships with other individuals.

det.analysis: significant(형용사) → significance(명사): 정관사 The 뒤 주어 자리이므로 명사 significance가 필요

questions.passage: This shows that the traits of human nature do not fully __________ (appearance) until the individual is brought into relationships with other individuals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: appearance(명사) → appear(동사): 조동사 do와 부사 fully 뒤 동사원형 자리이므로 appear가 필요

questions.passage: A ball thrown into the air is acted upon by the initial force given it, persisting as inertia of movement and tending to carry it in the same straight line, and by the constant pull of gravity downward, as well as by the resistance of the air. It moves, accordingly, in a curved path. Now the path does not represent the working of any particular force; there is simply the combination of the three elementary forces mentioned; but in a real sense, there is something in the total action besides the isolated action of three forces, namely, __________. In the same way, when two or more human individuals are together, their mutual relationships and their arrangement into a group are things which would not be revealed if we confined our attention to each individual separately. The significance of group behavior is greatly increased in the case of human beings by the fact that some of the tendencies to action of the individual are related definitely to other persons, and could not be aroused except by other persons acting as stimuli. An individual in complete isolation would not reveal their competitive tendencies, their tendencies towards the opposite sex, their protective tendencies towards children. This shows that the traits of human nature do not fully appear until the individual is brought into relationships with other individuals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 their joint action(그것들의 공동 작용)이 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① a single isolated force(하나의 고립된 힘): 개별 작용과 반대 개념
❌ ② the straight line alone(직선만으로): 문맥상 부적합
✅ ③ their joint action(그것들의 공동 작용): 세 힘의 개별 작용 외에 '공동 작용'이라는 전체 작용이 있다는 맥락 ← 정답
❌ ④ no combined effect(결합 효과 없음): 결합 작용을 강조하므로 정반대
det.tip: joint action = 공동 작용 (개별 작용 isolated action의 대비)

questions.passage: A ball thrown into the air is acted upon by the initial force given it, persisting as inertia of movement and tending to carry it in the same straight line, and by the constant pull of gravity downward, as well as by the resistance of the air. It moves, accordingly, in a curved path. Now the path does not represent the working of any particular force; there is simply the combination of the three elementary forces mentioned; but in a real sense, there is something in the total action besides the isolated action of three forces, namely, their joint action. In the same way, when two or more human individuals are together, their mutual relationships and their arrangement into a group are things which would not be revealed if we confined our attention to each individual separately. The significance of group behavior is greatly increased in the case of human beings by the fact that some of the tendencies to action of the individual are related definitely to other persons, and could not be aroused except by other persons acting as stimuli. An individual in complete isolation would not reveal their competitive tendencies, their tendencies towards the opposite sex, their protective tendencies towards children. This shows that the traits of human nature do not fully appear until the individual is __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 brought into relationships with other individuals(다른 개인들과의 관계 속에 놓이는)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① kept in complete isolation(완전한 고립 상태로 유지되는): 특성이 드러나지 않는 조건이므로 반대
✅ ② brought into relationships with other individuals(다른 개인들과의 관계 속에 놓이는): 인간 본성의 특성은 다른 개인들과의 관계 속에서 비로소 완전히 나타남 ← 정답
❌ ③ removed from any social group(어떤 사회 집단에서도 제거되는): 고립과 유사해 반대
❌ ④ studied entirely on its own(전적으로 단독으로 연구되는): 관계 속에서 드러난다는 논지와 반대
det.tip: brought into relationships = 관계 속에 놓이다. 고립(isolation)의 반대 조건

ch: brought into relationships with other individuals
